title: Parental ratings
description: Serves "They see only what they may.". A title's rating comes from the files beside it; a ceiling per account is part of the access rule (JS-036).
acceptanceCriteria: A title's rating comes from its own tags or the file beside it.
An operator gives an account a rating ceiling (JS-036); titles above it, and unrated titles if the operator says so, are hidden everywhere.
Every capability it adds is in the published contract (JS-183) and passes its conformance check.
